title: 3 Things We Need to See in Solo Leveling’s New Movie
content: After making fans wait for more than a year, A-1 Pictures confirmed a Solo Leveling film, which will follow the events after the second season. The film was announced during this year’s Anime Expo when fans from all over the world were keeping up with updates on upcoming projects.

title: Live-Action Fukakōryoku no I Love You Film Casts M!LK Idol Shunta Sono
content: The official website for the live-action film of Mizuki Hoshino 's Fukakōryoku no I Love You (I Love You by Force Majeure) manga revealed on Friday that the film has cast M!LK idol group member Shunta Sono as Saku's intuitive childhood friend Rentarō Akizuki.

title: 29 Years Later, Dragon Ball Ended Its Controversial 64-Episode Long Series That Fans Still Don’t Appreciate
content: For quite some time, many shonen fans believed that Dragon Ball GT would always be seen as the “Black Sheep” of the Z-Fighters’ franchise. Luckily, Dragon Ball Daima took quite a few elements from the Grand Tour in order to add some serious excitement to the original anime story.
author: ComicBook

title: Miss Delicious in Dungeon? This New 2027 Anime Could Be For You
content: An anime with similar vibes to Delicious in Dungeon will premiere next year, and fans would not want to miss it. There’s no denying that Delicious in Dungeon is one of the greatest fantasies of the 2020s. While the manga has already ended, the anime will be returning with a second season in October next year.
author: ComicBook
